briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Purify the Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak: Antechamber Seal. Enter Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak on Torii-Moon Mirror Road through The Torii-Moon Gate while the Gate remains Distortion Gate with ritual rerouting. Reference deity voice is Amaterasu, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, survive the boss approach in the Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak, secure the boss approach, and enter the chamber with the route law understood.

missionIntro.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: A clean crossing leaves no false reflection behind. The Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak will know whether one deity is enough.
missionIntro.speaker: Kami Deity Voice
missionIntro.text: The field asks for proof. One active deity enter, and The Spirit-Moon Gate will remember how we answer.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the pre boss pressure of Torii-Moon Mirror Road made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: purification streams that burn corruption and lies

victory.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
victory.text: The mirror clears; what remains is permitted to pass.
victory.speaker: Kami Deity Voice
victory.text: The Gate has not yielded. It has recorded that we did not break.

defeat.speaker: Amaterasu Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Torii-Moon Gate has learned too much from this attempt.
defeat.speaker: Kami Deity Voice
defeat.text: Fall back before the wound learns our full shape.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Sacred Kingdoms is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak as part of Torii-Moon Mirror Road.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Tengu Storm-Cedar Peak as a pre boss node in Torii-Moon Mirror Road; torii silhouettes, shrine lacquer red, white paper shide, braided shimenawa cords, mirror discs, foxfire blue, ink-wash smoke, cedar bark, moonlit silk, oni iron, tengu feather wind, dragon-rain scales, mask geometry, seasonal petals and ash.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable deity language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/deity language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
